content: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 241b-330a carries Sharḥ Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam, whose copy was completed in Shiraz on 3 Rabīʿ I 831/22 December 1427 (Ḥāʾirī, Majlis, 32/241); the other listed copies are MS 10082 (14 Shawwāl 835/14 June 1432), MS Mishkāt 1294 (20 Jumādā I 839/11 December 1435) and a partial copy at Kastamonu (1239/1822).
